subject.title: fix: recover stuck Control UI chat runs

question: Should maintainers port this ClawSweeper replacement watchdog onto the current `ui/src/pages/chat` runtime, replace it with another missed-terminal recovery design, or pause/close this PR and keep the linked issue open?
rationale: The useful fix intent remains, but the branch now targets deleted legacy modules and proof is still missing, so automation cannot safely choose the current-main design and proof/override policy by itself.

options.title: Port and prove on current main
options.body: Move the watchdog into the current chat lifecycle modules, preserve the queued-message tests, and require redacted browser/gateway proof before merge.

options.title: Replace with a different recovery design
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and implement a maintainer-owned current-main recovery path if the timer-based watchdog is not the desired product behavior.

options.title: Pause or close this PR
options.body: Close or pause this stale replacement branch if maintainers do not want to invest in porting and proof for this approach.

recommendation.title: Port and prove on current main
recommendation.body: Move the watchdog into the current chat lifecycle modules, preserve the queued-message tests, and require redacted browser/gateway proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties this person to stale run-state identity and the agent.wait-adjacent current-main paths that the port must align with.
